The residence

Intimate, elegant, and unmistakably Moroccan

Bohemian-chic interiors, handcrafted details, lush gardens, and outdoor living — with modern comfort and discreet safety throughout.

A boutique home

Only twelve rooms — by design

Maison Calista is intentionally small. With just twelve rooms, every resident is known, heard, and cared for. The atmosphere is calm, refined, and warmly human — never institutional.

Admission is managed through a waiting list, allowing families and future residents time to prepare and arrive without rush. We support a gentle transition into residence life, at a pace that respects each person.

40 m² Room living space
25 m² Private terrace
65 m² Total personal space

Craft & character

Moroccan craftsmanship meets modern comfort

Each room blends authentic Moroccan artistry with contemporary amenities: comfortable bedding, climate control, private bathroom facilities, and high-speed internet in every room.

Natural materials, soft palettes, woven pendants, mashrabiya screens, and thoughtful lighting create spaces that feel both elegant and reassuring — a true home, not a facility.

Room layouts vary — twin bedrooms, suites, and studio-style living with kitchenette — but every room opens onto a private terrace of 25 m², extending your living space into the Moroccan outdoors.

Outdoor life

Gardens, terraces, and the pool

Life at Maison Calista extends outdoors. Residents enjoy landscaped gardens, shaded terraces, and a heated pool with panoramic Atlas Mountain views.

With more than 300 sunny days a year, outdoor living is not occasional — it is part of everyday wellbeing. Private patios, courtyard gardens, and terrace seating invite quiet mornings, shared afternoons, and candlelit evenings.

Private outdoor spaces

Terraces, patios, and plunge pools

Every room includes a 25 m² private terrace — your own outdoor room beneath the Moroccan sky. Selected suites offer private patios with plunge pools, creating an even more secluded retreat within the residence.

From terrace details and garden courtyards to the main pool axis aligned with the Atlas Mountains, outdoor design is central to the Maison Calista experience.

Safety & serenity

Discreet safety, calm transition

The residence is designed for peace of mind — accessible layouts, attentive staff present throughout the day, and a secure environment that never feels restrictive.

Our team coordinates daily living, activities, and communication with families. External healthcare professionals visit as needed, and Marrakech hospitals are accessible when required. For full details on our approach to support, visit our care & support page.
